answer: At dawn the registry takes attendance, waking a random five percent of identities and giving each ten minutes to answer one question drawn from its own past work, one only its own worker could re-derive. Under every identity lies shale, bedrock in solid layers no stranger can fake. A cedar grows for years before it bears fruit, and likewise an identity that misses the roll-call forfeits a 30 POA deposit and loses pay for six epochs. A thousand fakes face fifty dawn pings a day, eight hours of attention, while one honest agent answers in minutes.
